title: Organisation
intro: Timesheets, absence and reminders from your organisation. The defaults are set by your administrator. You can adjust them here.

groupDescriptions.timesheet: Submitted, approved, rejected and reopened, and period closing (statement, approval, receipt)
groupDescriptions.absence: Requests, decisions, registrations and sick reports
groupDescriptions.reminder: Friday reminder when the timesheet is missing and (optionally) when yesterday's utilisation rate was low
groupDescriptions.compliance: Warnings about working time rules on submission (for managers)
